_comment: Copy to .work/harness/hooks.json (this machine) or tools/harness/hooks.json (everyone). Each event maps to commands run from the repo root with the event JSON in HARNESS_EVENT. Events: test_failed, test_crashed, client_crashed, client_restarted, test_quarantined, group_skipped, run_finished; "*" = every event. Every event is also appended to .work/harness/events.jsonl.
